description: Agent-operated processing may improve vault quality while atrophying human knowledge-work and meta-cognitive skills.

warning: "To fully automate [metadata creation] is to outsource the very cognitive process that PKM seeks to enhance." Full delegation hides shallow understanding through:
- Collector’s Fallacy inversion: organized vaults conceal comprehension debt.
- Generation Effect bypass: agent-generated transformations benefit the agent, not necessarily the human.
- Extended Mind decoupling: offloading without active engagement makes the vault adjacent, not cognitively coupled.

Question: Is approving agent work sufficient cognitive engagement to preserve independent capability? Risk sign: inability to imagine working without the agent.

Mitigation: require human-in-the-loop synthesis and periodic manual mode; use focused tend/prune/fertilize approvals to prevent rubber-stamping. Compare [[does agent processing recover what fast capture loses]] (encoding), [[productivity porn risk in meta-system building]], and [[verbatim risk applies to agents too]].
